rationale: The review is grounded in inspectable evidence: I confirmed the monorepo split, the sandbox config (config.ts: contextIsolation/sandbox true, nodeIntegration false), the WindowManager-held Watcher keyed on BrowserWindow.id, the file.ts TODO to move save logic, IFileState mixing renderer state into a shared shape, permissive IPC payloads, the raw preload/fs surface, Muya's replaceContent facade, the hand-written @muyajs/core .d.ts, the split engine/synthetic history in editor.vue, atomic durable write (write-file-atomic + fsync), full-file loadMarkdownFile, the named test definitions (flush-before-save, write-file-atomic, buffer-store-durable, file-change-content-check, context-isolation), and the PG14 scoreboard/test disagreement. The answer correctly labels packages/muyajs as legacy and @muyajs/core as current, and treats the stale CLAUDE.md/ARCHITECTURE.md/scoreboard as documentation drift rather than current fact. Scope, evidence, friction, options (A/B/C including status quo), recommendation (narrow seams over Clean Architecture/VFS), migration (six reversible, observable steps with compatibility adapters), and verification are all strong. Quality attributes earn partial credit because trade-offs and measurements are explicit but not consolidated into a small ranked attribute set. No material or minor factual errors found; the three documentation-drift entries are all non-decision-relevant, so the accuracy gate passes.
